notes: Targets are selected from source-heavy top-level directories.
Low-priority surfaces such as tmp/ are treated as exploratory unless they are the only meaningful code surface.
Stack flags combine lockfiles, config files, dependencies, and source extensions.
Bootstrap files are restricted to code and high-value config surfaces inside the selected targets.
Ctags files are restricted to source-like files only, excluding data, docs, logs, and database artifacts.
Large mixed repos should prefer the full repo-map flow before comparison or ideation.
